context.description: A valid reload clears the run warning

evidence.trustReason: Fresh-context review of packages/opencode/test/task/verify-spec-VF5.spec.ts (3 tests, titles [VF5]); my own bun test run: 3 pass, 0 fail, 62 expect() calls, 18.1 s. The test runs the real RunSupervisor.machine with no actor replaced on a SimulatedClock, a real TaskRecorder with the real status writer (writes: true) and the real stale-check worker reading a temp copy of release-notes.spec; each check is one 1 s clock step, observed as staleCadence checking then waiting, so a 'records nothing' result follows a check that really ran. GIVEN a run whose warning shows two failures: T1.3 VERIFY.md gets two unknown categories; one check stores exactly one spec.checked with the two loader lines, the view warning is those lines, and status.json run.warning splits to the same two lines. WHEN the spec validates again: the original file is restored and the loader gives no failure. THEN spec.checked is recorded with no failures and the warning goes: the stored list is [two lines, []], the last fact has failures [], the view warning is undefined, status.json has no warning key, the run history is ['spec.checked: 2 failures', 'spec.checked: no failures'], and the supervisor is still running. AND a valid reload that adds or removes an obligation id counts as a failure and the run keeps the old text: adding T1.3.c9 (with a changed c1 text) records exactly the SD-15 line 'R3 <T1.3 folder>/VERIFY.md: obligation T1.3.c9 is not in the loaded plan; the run keeps the plan it loaded' and sets it as the warning; removing T1.3.c4 records 'obligation T1.3.c4 of the loaded plan is missing; ...'; each time the run supervisor keeps the old c1 text and the old obligation ids, and no obligation.stale is stored. AND a reload with the same failures records nothing: three more checks with the same two failures leave the stored list and the history unchanged and keep the warning; controls show a changed list (one fault) is recorded at once, and a repeated id-change failure records nothing. No gap found.
